title: Day one. 7:45 a.m.
intro: Your own house, in a town you've lived in for three weeks. Your own life. A good, ordinary morning.

items.label: The lease, on the table
items.text: Month-to-month. The landlord has circled 'sign for the year?' twice. You've been meaning to. You keep meaning to.

items.label: Your phone
items.text: A voicemail from home: 'Call me when you've decided, love. Whatever it is. I'll back you.' You decide to not decide until you've had coffee.

items.label: Your notebook
items.text: A new notebook, mostly blank. Page one, in your own hand: 'WRITE IT DOWN. You always think you'll remember.' Good advice. You have a phone camera too: you can photograph anything you want to keep.

items.label: Calendar from the diner
items.text: FOUNDERS' DAY, 10 Sept, circled in red by someone who isn't you. Under it: 'Same time tomorrow!' You aren't sure what the town does on Founders' Day. Everyone has been strangely vague about it.

items.label: A neighbour's mail
items.text: A letter for a Mr. Okoro, delivered to you by mistake. 'FORWARDING: none.' The postmark is three weeks old. His house, next door, has had its curtains drawn all month.

items.label: A stray cat
items.text: A grey stray has made itself at home on your porch. It rubs against your legs, purring, completely unbothered. You've never had a pet. It's decided you're staff.

items.label: The window
items.text: The lake, very still, very blue. Someone waves at it from the road, as someone does every morning. You've started doing it too, without noticing when you started.

items.label: The kitchen clock
items.text: An hour wrong. Every clock in town is an hour wrong. The landlord says it's 'Mercy Time'. Nobody has ever been able to tell you why.

items.label: Unpacked boxes
items.text: Three of them. 'KITCHEN?' 'BOOKS' and 'MISC (SCARY)'. You open MISC (SCARY). It is mostly cables.

items.label: A dying houseplant
items.text: A gift from your mum. It has been dying since the day you got it. You have named it Optimism.

items.label: Mirror
items.text: Yours. Familiar. A bit tired. The coffee is on its way.

items.label: Kettle
items.text: It's slow. It has always been slow. You use the wait to not think about the lease.
